title.en: MALACAÑANG MANDATING THE METROPOLITAN MANILA DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY TO GIVE ALL THE NECESSARY ASSISTANCE TO THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT OF BACOOR IN CONNECTION WITH DEVELOPMENT PLANNING, TRANSPORT AND TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT, SOLID WASTE DISPOSAL AND MANAGEMENT, FLOOD CONTROL AND SEWERAGE MANAGEMENT

text.en:
NOW, THEREFORE, I, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO,
President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested
in me by law, do hereby order the Metropolitan Manila Development
Authority to provide all the necessary assistance needed by the Local
Government of Bacoor in the development planning, transport and traffic
management, flood control management and solid waste disposal.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th
2010 at the City of Manila, Philippines.
Marie M.lungs
By the President:
LEANDRO R. MENDOZA
Executive Secyetary
POMA Hologram • 57434
